verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a concrete, protocol-level cart API (createcart/getcart) with request/response schemas, plus create_order and create_product tools in the agent toolkit that agents can call via MCP/LangChain/etc. to create and manage carts or orders. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully drives cart creation end-to-end (only first-party docs), and cart update (vs. create/get) semantics are thin.
